title: Reading bands versus Dixieland bands: Tuxedo, Peerless, Celestin
summary: Which bands read music and which played Dixieland, including Celestin's Tuxedo.

blocks.x: That's nothing could be finer than being Carolina in the Mar.
Yeah, that's the name of it.
Yeah, I remember that piece. Well now who were the bands that played mostly society music, just reading, no Dixieland?

Well Tuxedo, very little reading they had though, I ain't going to lie. I'll tell you the band that had the real readers in it, P-Rong, A.J. P-Rong. Did they play any Dixieland? They played Dixieland but they played a lot of the music, beautiful numbers and things you know? Yeah. Yeah.
And what about Celestan's Tuxedo? What would he feature?

Well they had, I remember they played Moise Dixieland see? He played Moise Dixieland. Of course he'd know a song from way back though, that helped him see? He played solid Dixieland. How long were you with Jack Carey?
